summary: QXO, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding its subsidiary's private placement of $3.0B in senior notes (6.500% 2031 and 6.875% 2034) to finance the planned acquisition of TopBuild Corp. Proceeds are held in escrow pending deal consummation, with a mandatory redemption if the acquisition fails. The notes are initially secured by escrowed assets and will become guaranteed by QXO upon closing. No specific terms (price/share, premium) are disclosed. Risk-arb: monitor regulatory clearance and financing conditions; note escrow structure limits noteholder exposure until deal closes.
